<context_for_action>
The apt-get timeout occurred during the final package downloads (118/119 complete) but packages weren't installed. Since the packages are likely cached in /var/cache/apt/archives, completing the interrupted install with `apt-get install -f` or rerunning the same apt-get command (even with the full package list) should finish quickly - it just needs to unpack/configure already-downloaded packages, not re-download them. This may be faster than switching to a minimal install approach.
</context_for_action>
